test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Many developing nations are having a ___________ economy these days.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"booming"** means experiencing a period of great prosperity or rapid economic growth. (तेजी से बढ़ता हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **The country's **booming **economy has led to a higher standard of living for its citizens.
 
 
 
• **"Boosting"** refers to increasing or improving something. (बढ़ावा देना)
 
 
• **Example: **Various initiatives are aimed at** boosting** the local economy.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to describe the economy of many developing nations is **'booming'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Boosting **(बढ़ावा देना): Refers to increasing or improving something.

 
 
• **Example:** Various initiatives are aimed at **boosting** the local economy.
 
 
 
• **Resounding **(गूंजता हुआ): Producing or characterized by a deep, resonant sound.
 
 
• **Example: **Her **resounding** voice filled the auditorium.
 
 
 
• **Ringing** (घंटी बजाना): Producing a clear, resonant sound.
 
 
• **Example:** The** ringing **of the church bells was heard across the town.
 
 

49:Tb69,

The correct answer is **Option 4)**
